entries.title: Psalms 66:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A song, a Psalm.>> Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:

entries.title: Psalms 66:2
segments: Sing forth the glory of his name: Make his praise glorious.

entries.title: Psalms 66:3
segments: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 66:4
segments: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 66:5
segments: Come, and see the works of God; [He is] terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 66:6
segments: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot: There did we rejoice in him.

entries.title: Psalms 66:7
segments: He ruleth by his might for ever; His eyes observe the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 66:8
segments: Oh bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of his praise to be heard;

entries.title: Psalms 66:9
segments: Who holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 66:10
segments: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

entries.title: Psalms 66:11
segments: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.

entries.title: Psalms 66:12
segments: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

entries.title: Psalms 66:13
segments: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,

entries.title: Psalms 66:14
segments: Which my lips uttered, And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.

entries.title: Psalms 66:15
segments: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 66:16
segments: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 66:17
segments: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 66:18
segments: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:

entries.title: Psalms 66:19
segments: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 66:20
segments: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me.
